Blaster was a Human Blaster wore a Phase I clone trooper helmet adorned with the red markings of the Coruscant Guard armor. Like all clones, Blaster stood 1.83 meters tall and had a tan skin complexion.

page.overview:
Who is Blaster?

Blaster was a Human Blaster wore a Phase I clone trooper helmet adorned with the red markings of the Coruscant Guard armor. Like all clones, Blaster stood 1.83 meters tall and had a tan skin complexion.

Blaster's helmet featured in the third set of Star Wars Squeeze Meez, The trooper was named "Blaster" in the product packaging.

Category:Coruscant Guard troopers Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns Category:Males
